name: Punjabi
description: Hearty, flavour-packed North Indian classics — from buttery dal makhani to sizzling tandoori platters. Bold spices, rich gravies, and the warmth of the Punjab, served fresh daily.

items.name: Dal Makhani
items.description: Slow-cooked black lentils in a creamy tomato-butter sauce, finished with a dash of cream. A North Indian staple that never disappoints.

items.name: Butter Chicken
items.description: Tender chicken in a velvety tomato-cream sauce, lightly spiced and perfectly balanced. Best enjoyed with fresh naan.

items.name: Paneer Tikka
items.description: Marinated cottage cheese cubes grilled in the tandoor until golden and fragrant. Served with mint chutney.

items.name: Tandoori Roti
items.description: Freshly made whole-wheat flatbread baked in a clay tandoor. Soft inside, slightly charred outside.

name: Gujarati
description: A celebration of Gujarat's culinary heritage — sweet, savoury, and spiced in perfect harmony. Traditional thali meals and regional specialities that feel like home.

items.name: Gujarati Thali
items.description: A complete Gujarati meal with dal, sabzi, kadhi, rice, rotli, papad, pickle, and a sweet. Comfort in every bite.

items.name: Steamed Dhokla
items.description: Light, spongy chickpea-flour cakes, tempered with mustard seeds and curry leaves. A Gujarati classic for any time of day.

items.name: Undhiyu
items.description: A slow-cooked winter delicacy of mixed vegetables and fenugreek dumplings, bursting with authentic Gujarati spice.

items.name: Khaman
items.description: Soft and fluffy chickpea-flour snack with a sweet-sour-spicy tadka. Perfect for breakfast or a light snack.

name: South Indian
description: Crisp dosas, fluffy idlis, and aromatic sambars — authentic South Indian flavours made with time-honoured recipes and the freshest ingredients.

items.name: Masala Dosa
items.description: A crisp, golden rice crêpe filled with spiced potato masala. Served with coconut chutney and sambar.

items.name: Idli Sambar (3 pcs)
items.description: Fluffy steamed rice cakes served with a tangy lentil sambar and fresh coconut chutney. A South Indian morning staple.

items.name: Medu Vada (2 pcs)
items.description: Crispy fried lentil doughnuts with a soft interior. Served with coconut chutney and sambar.

items.name: Uthappam
items.description: Thick, soft rice pancakes topped with onions, tomatoes, and green chillies. A wholesome South Indian favourite.

name: Chinese
description: Indo-Chinese favourites with the bold flavours Navsari loves — from fried rice to fiery Manchurian. Quick, satisfying, and crowd-pleasing.

items.name: Veg Fried Rice
items.description: Wok-tossed basmati rice with fresh vegetables, soy sauce, and spring onions. A comforting crowd-pleaser.

items.name: Paneer Manchurian
items.description: Crispy cottage cheese in a tangy, spicy Manchurian sauce. Perfect with fried rice or hakka noodles.

items.name: Veg Hakka Noodles
items.description: Stir-fried noodles with crunchy vegetables and a savoury soy-chilli sauce. Quick and delicious.

items.name: Veg Spring Rolls (4 pcs)
items.description: Golden, crispy rolls packed with spiced mixed vegetables. Served with sweet chilli dipping sauce.
